card.binding.title: Most restrictive limit right now
settings.group.help: Accounts with a used-up quota move to a collapsible group with their return time. Display only: the manual order inside each group and the order saved in the file stay as they are.

card.pace.estimate: Linear estimate from the use so far; it may change.
settings.order.title: Account order
settings.order.help: Shows the accounts closest to their limit first. The manual order (drag and drop, shared with the TUI) stays saved and returns when this is off.
